messages:
Samira Patel: Sorry for the ping — heading to ER with a family member. Im scheduled primary for tonight (UK bank holiday) from 18:00-02:00 UTC and won't be able to take pages. Need someone to cover entire window or split. Really sorry for the short notice.

Incident Bot: Pager reminder: active rotation tonight: Samira Patel (primary), Omar Haddad (secondary). To claim shift run `/claim-oncall <start> <end>`.

Omar Haddad: @Samira sending good vibes. I can cover primary 18:00-22:00 UTC. After 22:00 I have a customer call (APAC) that I can't miss. Someone needs 22:00-02:00.

Noah Park: I can pick up 22:00-02:00 UTC but Im remote and bandwidth might be limited between 23:30-00:30 (meeting). I can be primary otherwise and rely on escalation bot for paging during that 1 hour.

Samira Patel: Thanks both. Important runbook bits for tonight in case the embeddings/streaming route flares (leaving a compact checklist):
1) Check incident index: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-9876 (the earlier noise)
2) Metrics to watch: 99p latency (embeddings), error-rate, cpu throttling on model workers
3) Quick mitigations: scale pool, toggle kev-cache warmup, switch routing policy to cross-region `eu->us-failover` if region saturates
4) If customers see >3% 5xx or a growing bridge request, start an incident bridge and page SRE primary.

CLI snippets: 
```
redwoodctl metrics query "p99_latency{service=\"embeddings\",region=\"eu-west-1\"}" --window 5m
redwoodctl pool scale --region eu-west-1 --pool embeddings-worker --replicas 10
redwoodctl routing set-policy --region eu-west-1 --policy eu->us-failover
```

Samira Patel: Also note the holiday traffic pattern: lower request volume but heavier long-tail batch jobs from a few accounts starting midnight GMT. If tail spikes after 00:00, prefer scaling over routing changes first.

Omar Haddad: ACK. I'll put a status update in the rota and set my phone to urgent-only. Will watch KV cache warmups and HPA.

Noah Park: Taking 22:00-02:00. I'll be available on phone except 23:30-00:30 meeting window — Omar will be secondary until 22:00 and Escalation Bot will take over during my meeting with a strict page policy.

Escalation Bot: Escalation policy set: page SRE > page infra-oncall if repeated 5xx within 10m OR p99 > 600ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows.

Omar Haddad: Quick coordination note for handoffs: when handing off, include last 5m of `p99_latency`, `error_rate`, and whether you triggered any pool scale. Leave a short handoff message like `handoff: p99=520ms, errs=0.6%, scaled=+4` so the next primary has context.

Noah Park: Will do. Ill post a one-liner handoff at 00:00.

Samira Patel: Appreciate you both. If anything escalates before Im out of reach, trust the runbook and escalate per policy. Ill check messages later tonight but may be offline.

Incident Bot: Shift reassign recorded: Omar Haddad primary 18:00-22:00; Noah Park primary 22:00-02:00; Omar Haddad listed as secondary 22:00-02:00. Reminder sent to mobile.

Noah Park: Handover note (22:00): handoff: p99=480ms, errs=0.3%, scaled=+2 at 21:45, no open bridges. I'm primary now, monitoring embeddings in eu-west-1.

Omar Haddad: Confirming receipt. Leaving my phone on. Good luck and take care, @Samira. :heart:
